profile.summary: First 5 Alameda County invests in early childhood systems in Alameda County. It funds community organizations that serve young children and families, partners with parents, providers and public agencies, and supports programs such as family resource navigation, access to affordable child care and provider training. It also advocates for public policies that support young children.
